title: Lessee Share Points on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Arrears Payment
content:
Customers who hold a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease alongside a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract receive share points on an arrears payment taken toward an extension of the retail contract.

**Rule.** When the customer holds an active Kestrel lease (a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease in active status) and the customer's Kestrel lease ledger shows at least 12 lease payments and no lease late charge in the last 12 calendar months, 10 percentage points are taken off the arrears share; when the customer holds an active Kestrel lease and the lease ledger shows no more than one lease late charge in the last 12 calendar months, where the first condition is not met, 5 points are taken off; in every other case no points are taken off.

The points come off the arrears share that applies to the contract, which is then applied once to the other past-due amount.

## Input, judgement, output

| Input from the lease records | Judgement | Points taken off the arrears share |
|---|---|---|
| Active lease; 12 or more lease payments; no lease late charge (last 12 calendar months) | full | 10 |
| Active lease; fewer than 12 lease payments; no more than one lease late charge | partial | 5 |
| Active lease; 12 or more lease payments; exactly one lease late charge | partial | 5 |
| Active lease; two or more lease late charges | none | 0 |
| No active lease | none | 0 |

**Counting.** Lease payments and lease late charges are the entries on the customer's Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease ledger, by their dates. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

*Hypothetical:* on an arrears share of 80 percent, a lessee meeting the full condition brings it to 70 percent; one meeting only the partial condition brings it to 75 percent.
